blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation applied to Streaming & Digital Platforms. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Streaming platforms live on two curves: engagement (personalization, discovery, retention) and unit economics (encoding, delivery, churn). Both are decision engines — and both run better on governed telemetry, evaluation-driven ML and cost telemetry.

items: Cancellation intents handled at save-desk; churn prediction un-wired to actions.
Recommendations plateau without governance over objectives (engagement vs. Satisfaction).

blocks.x: The pattern composes Hyperautomation & Systems Integration, Intelligent Document Processing, Intelligent Document Processing from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Personalization/discovery, Subscriber lifecycle, Delivery cost management) on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Nexus and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — Privacy/consent among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Agents that execute the work: tool-using, policy-bounded, and fully logged for audit.
Agents operated as one fleet: roles, queues, budgets and audit trails.

Intent signals triggering save actions in-product (churn down in cohorts)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Telecom, Media & Entertainment level this capability reads as: install/repair tasking with skills, parts and SLA routing (first-time-fix rate up). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Programs run on a fixed rhythm so progress is visible from week one. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
